theorems.name: Submission.lpf_lli_inner_compact_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (A : Set (Eucl P)), NullMeasurableSet A μ → SigmaFinite (μ.restrict A) → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), (∀ k, IsCompact (C k)) ∧ (∀ k, C k ⊆ A) ∧ μ (A \ ⋃ k, C k) = 0
